fact: A contract award notice dated 17 September 2026 records the recruitment of a firm to give technical assistance to the Ministry of National Education (MEN/A/PL) in developing the master plan for its SIGE, at a contract value of XOF 40,362,420.
title: Awarded - Recruitment of a firm to provide technical assistance to the Ministry of National Education, Literacy and Promotion (MEN/A/PL) in developing the master plan for the Information Systems Management System (SIGE). - 8426527 - Niger
